method.primary: Section-constrained stable-ts forced alignment of unaltered approved lyric lines, repeated chorus text expanded in working copy only; small.en + medium.en faster-whisper CPU int8.

method.separation: Demucs htdemucs, CPU, shifts=0; isolated vocals, no source replacement.
method.signal_analysis: 200–5000 Hz 3rd-order Butterworth bandpass; 441-sample (10 ms) RMS bins at 44100 Hz. CH3 onset sustained 80 ms >-35 dBFS; CH2/CH3 ends sustained 150 ms <-35 dBFS. Energy alone cannot identify words.
